notes: 6 literature positives + 28 in-silico negatives (16 hotspot Ala mutants + 12 composition-preserving shuffles).
Negatives are presumed negatives with construction provenance; not experimentally validated as non-binders.
FPR resolution at n_neg=28 is ~3.6%, sufficient for the FPR<=5% claim.
Binding metadata (project_id/approved_digest/protocol) is filled at scoring time by scripts/score_control_dataset.py; nothing is baked in.
